D/ IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES ; R/ BEATA TRANQUILLITAS

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus of Crispus dating AD317-326, reverse: BEATA TRANQVILLITAS. Reece period 16. Mint Trier. Dimensions: diameter: 19.56mm; weight: 3.31g. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust left with spear and shield. Obverse inscription: IVL CRISPVS NOB CAES. Reverse: Altar with VOTIS XX inscribed. Reverse inscription: BEATA TRANQUILLITAS. Mint mark: -/-//ST[-]. Die axis…
